title: yarn.lock dependency lockfile served
description: The response is a Yarn lockfile: the yarn lockfile header followed by resolved package entries with their integrity hashes. It is the exact dependency graph of the front end.
remediation: Exclude lockfiles from the deployed tree and deny them at the server level.
limitation: One response body. The rule reads the lockfile header; it does not resolve the package versions.

observation.body:
# THIS IS AN AUTOGENERATED FILE. DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE DIRECTLY.
# yarn lockfile v1


left-pad@^1.3.0:
  version "1.3.0"
  resolved "https://registry.yarnpkg.com/left-pad/-/left-pad-1.3.0.tgz#5b8a3a7765dfe001261dde915589e782f8c94d1e"

# yarn lockfile v1

ms@2.1.3:
  version "2.1.3"
  resolved "https://registry.yarnpkg.com/ms/-/ms-2.1.3.tgz#574c8138ce1d2b5861f0b44579dbadd60c6615b2"
